content.heading: LETTER OF APPOINTMENT
content.introduction: We are pleased to offer you the position of “Sample Position” upon the following terms and conditions.

sections.heading: 1. DATE OF COMMENCEMENT

clauses.text: . Any required work authorisation or visa must be obtained before you begin work.

clauses: Your probation period will be 3 months. Confirmation will be based on your performance and communicated to you in writing.

sections.heading: 2. SALARY

clauses.text: Your basic monthly salary will be
(all inclusive only of expressly stated components).

clauses: As required by law
No other allowances are included unless agreed in writing.
Salary payment timing: Monthly
Approved business travel and work-related expenses will be reimbursed under Company policy.

sections.heading: 3. DUTIES
clauses: You are required to perform duties reasonably assigned within the framework of your role and profile.
Sample duties

sections.heading: 4. OTHER WORK
clauses: This is a full-time position. You are expected to devote your working time to the Company.
Obtain written approval before taking up other paid work or an advisory role that may conflict with your duties or the Company’s interests.
Requires approval

sections.heading: 5. WORKING HOURS
clauses: Your ordinary working arrangements are: Standard hours.
Work beyond ordinary hours will be managed and compensated where required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 6. ANNUAL LEAVE
clauses: 14 days
Leave requests and any unpaid leave are subject to the applicable law and the Company’s leave procedures.

sections.heading: 7. SICK LEAVE
clauses: Notify the Company or your manager as soon as practicable if illness prevents you from working.
As applicable

sections.heading: 8. TERMINATION AND NOTICE
clauses: Either party may terminate employment by giving One month. Salary in lieu may be paid where permitted by law.
The Company may take disciplinary action, including termination, for misconduct or a material breach, following applicable law.
On termination, you must return Company and client property and support an orderly handover.

sections.heading: 9. CONFIDENTIALITY
clauses: You must not disclose confidential Company or client information except as authorised or required by law.
Confidential information includes non-public trade, business, financial, client, personnel and technical information.
These obligations continue after employment for as long as the information remains confidential.
You must not copy, retain or destroy Company confidential information without written authorisation.

sections.heading: 10. BENEFITS
clauses: Standard benefits
Benefit eligibility, coverage and administration are subject to the applicable plan terms and Company policy.

sections.heading: 11. GOVERNING LAW
clauses: This letter and your employment are subject to the applicable employment laws of Singapore.
Any contractual term that provides less than a mandatory legal entitlement is subject to that entitlement.

sections.heading: 12. ADDITIONAL TERMS
clauses: Sample terms
